title: add pluggable init-probe support and k8s cert-rotation preflight hook
author: Priya Ramesh
release_notes: Add pluggable init probe extension points and a configurable cert-rotation preflight hook used during upgrades/imports. No breaking changes to existing values; new fields are opt-in.
description:
Motivation: Private installs need two things that have come up repeatedly in enterprise engagements: (1) the ability to run tenant- or environment-specific logic during init without forking charts, and (2) a safe, observable pre-upgrade certificate rotation path that can integrate with customer KMS/HSM. This PR introduces a small plugin surface for init probes and a Helm templated preflight cert-rotation hook with backoff and dry-run modes.

What this changes (summary): added a pluggable init-probe contract in values.schema, new ConfigMap+Job templates for probe bundles, a cert-rotation cronjob/hook template that can be toggled per-release, and docs + examples for Terraform module wiring. The change includes a lightweight Go helper container image reference (configurable) used by init jobs to execute probe bundles and emit structured status to /var/log/init-probes.json for the operator to surface.

Checklist: - [x] values.schema.json entries and validation - [x] Helm templates for init probe configmap, job, and hook - [x] Example values.yaml for airgap and non-airgap flows - [x] Terraform README showing integration points - [x] Unit tests for template rendering and CI smoke pipeline

Commits: See commits summary below for granular changes.

Files touched (high level): templates/init-probe-configmap.yaml, templates/init-probe-job.yaml, templates/preflight-cert-rotation-hook.yaml, values.schema.json, charts/redwood-private/Chart.yaml (chart version bump), examples/helm/values-cert-rotation.yaml, docs/operational/cert-rotation.md, third_party/terraform/modules/cert-rotation/README.md, README.md (installer docs).

Behavior notes: - The init probe system is opt-in: users enable probes via values.private.init.probes.enabled and provide a list of probe artifacts (configmap or OCI image refs). When enabled, the installer creates an init ConfigMap and a short-lived Job that runs before the main tenant bootstrap. Probe Job behavior is guarded by a probeTimeout and probeRetries field. - The cert-rotation hook supports `mode: dry-run|apply`, a rotation window (cron-style) and an explicit `kmsProvider` field so customers can point it at their key manager. The hook emits Prometheus metrics (probe_success, rotation_attempt) and logs structured JSON to stdout. - Pre-upgrade flow: the chart adds a Hook annotation for pre-upgrade with weight and a canary label so operators can opt to run rotation only on a subset of namespaces first.

Testing and CI: Helm template rendering tests (helm unittest) were added to validate values combinations. CI runs lint, unit render tests, and an integration smoke where the preflight job is rendered but not executed. All CI checks passed on the final revision.

Review highlights / conversation (abridged): - Sasha: asked for clearer failure semantics for probe Jobs (should not block install forever). I added probeRetries + backoff and documented it. - Diego: requested the KMS provider shape be extensible for HSM; I added a generic provider map and an example for HashiCorp Vault + HSM. - Lin: asked for metrics naming and unit. Updated templates to emit prometheus annotations and added a short metrics doc. - QA: requested an airgap-friendly example; included an examples/helm/values-cert-rotation-airgap.yaml and notes for image pre-pull.

Merge outcome: squash-merged into main after approvals from Sasha and Diego and green CI.
